name: Annual Leave
eligibilityText: All confirmed employees. Accrues from the date of joining and becomes available once probation ends.
accrualRuleText: 1.5 days for each completed month of service.
carryForwardRuleText: Up to 30 days may be carried into the next year. Anything above the cap lapses on 31 December.
noticeRuleText: Three working days of notice, except in an emergency agreed with the reporting manager.

name: Sick Leave
eligibilityText: All employees from the date of joining.
accrualRuleText: Credited in full on 1 January, or on joining for a new employee, pro-rated for the remaining months.
carryForwardRuleText: Sick leave does not carry forward and lapses on 31 December.
noticeRuleText: Inform the reporting manager on the first day of absence.

name: Casual Leave
eligibilityText: All employees from the date of joining.
accrualRuleText: Credited in full on 1 January, pro-rated on joining.
carryForwardRuleText: Casual leave does not carry forward and lapses on 31 December.

name: Maternity Leave
eligibilityText: As provided by the Maternity Benefit Act. Granted on application with supporting medical documentation.
accrualRuleText: Not accrued. Granted per instance rather than per year.
noticeRuleText: Thirty days of notice where circumstances allow.

name: Paternity Leave
eligibilityText: Granted on application, to be taken within six months of the birth.
accrualRuleText: Not accrued. Granted per instance rather than per year.
noticeRuleText: Seven days of notice where circumstances allow.

name: Leave Without Pay
eligibilityText: Available once paid leave is exhausted, with the approval of the reporting manager.
accrualRuleText: No entitlement is accrued; each request is approved on its own merits.
